title: polypodium ellipticum var. pothifolium
intro: Polypodium ellipticum var. pothifolium, commonly known as Pacific Polypody, is a species of fern belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress, improve skin health, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Pacific Polypody include its ability to act as an analgesic, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful for treating various health conditions such as wounds, skin irritations, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Pacific Polypody include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
